no-restricted-syntax.message: Off-scale text size. DESIGN.md Typography defines a 4-step ramp (10px section labels / 11px meta+tool lines / 13px body / 14px titles); 8, 9, 10.5, 11.5 and 12.5 are not steps on it. Use the nearest step (8|9 -> 10, 10.5 -> 10 for section labels or 11 for meta lines, 11.5 -> 11, 12.5 -> 13). src/renderer/components/Terminal/** is exempt: the terminal owns its own scale.
